trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum is yours. It is the last one you will unlock, so treat the roadmap tab as the order of work and let this one take care of itself.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and the trophy pops when it ends. It is the first story beat, so it cannot be missed as long as you keep a manual save from before the mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full. Story chapters unlock in order, so keep playing the main missions until the chapter closes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 in full. Same as the other chapter trophies: follow the story missions until the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 in full. Keep working through the story missions in order.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 in full. The story missions carry you here; there is no side requirement.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. One trophy, one ending: complete the last mission and the gold is yours.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission, so it unlocks as you play through the campaign in order.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Follow the story until this heist mission appears, then finish it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission like the others in this set; play the campaign in order.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. It unlocks through the story, so keep the main missions going.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story-gated: it appears as you work through the campaign.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the story mission when it unlocks.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent completion across everything the game counts: story, side content, collectibles and activities. This is the long grind and the last gold before the platinum; use the checklist to see what is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts anywhere in Leonida. Stunts build up through normal driving and riding, so chase jumps and near-misses whenever you travel and the count climbs on its own.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Work through the activities list — racing, fishing, arcade games, drone races and the rest — one of each is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range challenge grades you, so learn the targets and pacing per challenge and repeat until gold; the count in the tracker shows how many you have golded.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Visit each drone race spot on the map and win there; a win at a location counts once.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts as long as the race itself is one you have not won before, so spread your wins across new events.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, then out-fish him; no count is tracked, so a single win does it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade machine and play it through to the end of a game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Stranger missions unlock as you meet Andy out in Leonida; finish his whole strand to reach his final mission, and keep a manual save before it in case the strand locks off.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's stranger strand to its last mission and finish it.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's stranger strand; his last mission is the one that pops this.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more strands than the eight you need, so pick any eight and finish each one to its end.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's stranger strand to its final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Work through Tyrone's strand until its last mission, then finish it.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. The spots are spread over the map; visit each one and meditate there, and the tracker counts the spots you have done.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at one particular animal; track it and take it down, and keep a save before the hunt in case it only comes once.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; finish any three full sets to pop this.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK spots are spread across the state; hit 100 of them and the count is done.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges run through the whole game, so keep clearing them as you play and the count climbs toward 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and get clear without being caught.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row, keep your partner with you, and stay wanted the whole time — if the heat drops, start the run again.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you find counts once; drive or ride anything you have not discovered yet and the list fills up.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Warm up at a shooting range first to learn the timing, then trigger Combat Focus in a fight with five enemies close together and drop all five before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. The description points at the airport; no cited source pins down the exact step yet, so treat it as a one-off moment at VCIA and keep a manual save before trying anything there.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the tanks, so this one is about them; no cited source pins down the exact trigger yet, so expect it to come from an encounter with a Rhino rather than a step you can plan.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff spotting you, and get out with the take before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five vaults and get clear after each one; the tracker counts vaults robbed and escaped from.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find a truck on its route, hit it, and get away clean.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The map tracks 52 areas; visit each one and the count fills in as you cover the state.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs, so you need one illegal operation from each; the count shows how many gangs you have hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach and order the cocktail at the spot with the view; it reads as a one-off moment, so keep a manual save before it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. It points at a showroom break-out; no cited source pins down which showroom or the exact step, so treat it as a one-off and keep a save before trying a showroom.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and follow through on the game; keep a manual save before it in case the moment only comes once.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague and no cited source pins down the exact trigger yet; expect a partnership moment rather than a step you can plan, and let it come as you play.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PlayStation tracks 500 choices across the campaign, so keep playing and choosing; the count fills in over a full playthrough rather than in one place.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt; no cited source pins down which moment it means, so keep playing and let it come.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description hints at something strange; no cited source pins down the exact trigger yet, so expect an odd encounter out in Leonida rather than a step you can plan.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a melee weapon, not a gun.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from jobs; pass $250,000 of them through your contacts and the total counts toward the target.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop spending counts, so buy gear, clothes and supplies as you play and the total climbs.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every one of the 8 garage properties across Leonida.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, then register each one in the Scooter Bros app until you have ten.
